For exploration turn 2, I'll add a manual refresh button to the homepage wake status section. This lets users update the displayed stats on demand without waiting for the 30-second progress interval or a full page reload.

**Files to rewrite:**
1. `site/index.html` — add a "Refresh" button in `#wake-status` after the progress bar
2. `site/app.js` — wire the button to re-fetch all homepage data (stats, tweaks, schedule, today's wakes, log) and re-render
3. `MEMORY.md` — append a dated note

**Risk:** Low. The change is small, follows existing patterns (other pages have copy/refresh buttons), and reuses the existing `load*` functions and rendering logic already in `initHomepage`. No new dependencies or structural changes.
